notes: 'that which' is a headless relative whose present אֲשֶׁר takes both words under rule 46's first rider, headed on 'which'.
The suffix of כָמֹהוּ goes unrepresented beside 'the like', no part of that two-word phrase answering to it in particular (rule 22); the competing fusion is named in the unit's note.
'because of' is one rendering of יַעַן and fuses, headed on 'because' (rules 30, 24).
